currentSourcePass.summary: The major caveats are now resolvable as normalization policies rather than blockers. Dynamic facts such as schedules, seasonal bridges, fire bans, ferry operation, and hut services remain publication-date rechecks. Several standalone POI caveats are source-exhausted because public sources verify the service at the hut/camp but do not publish separate coordinates.

displayDistancePolicy.decision: Use official operator/source display distances in the candidate trail data and preserve computed geometry length separately for normalization QA.
displayDistancePolicy.rationale: The source set consistently shows 0.5-1.5 km differences caused by endpoint snaps, grouped GPX splits, boat/access inclusion, and rounding. Replacing official stage distances with computed line length would hide source contradictions and make user-facing distances unstable.
sectionSpecificRules: Stage 1: preserve official 2 + 14 km; model Ritsem-Änonjálmme as boat access and Änonjálmme/Gisuris as walking geometry.
Stage 8: preserve official 13 km while flagging computed linework around 11.55-11.61 km.

Stage 9: preserve STF 6 km as primary official display if following STF stage inventory; if the app requires geometry-rounded display, use 7 km and cite Naturkartan/Padjelanta/computed linework. Do not silently collapse this contradiction.
Stage 10: display as 12 km walking + 3 km boat/access, not as one continuous hiking distance.
displayDistancePolicy.remainingAction: Normalization pass should add explicit fields for officialDisplayDistance, computedGeometryKm, and distanceContradictions.

geometryPolicy.decision: Use official/public route linework as the canonical walking geometry, split grouped Naturkartan GPX files at documented indices, and model boat/ferry legs as access connectors rather than hiking geometry.
geometryPolicy.rationale: The best geometry sources are grouped Naturkartan GPXs and OSM relations. Hut centroids, ferry terminals, and route-line endpoints do not always coincide; forcing every route endpoint to hut coordinates would introduce artificial line segments.
rules: Do not import full grouped Naturkartan GPXs as single sections.
Do not extend a route to a hut centroid unless the route-line gap is small or a visible access path supports the extension.
Where endpoint gap is more than roughly 50-100 m, preserve route-line endpoint and attach the hut as a nearby facility/access note unless later geometry review proves a connector.
Treat Stage 1 Ritsem-Änonjálmme and Stage 10 Bobäcken-Kvikkjokk as boat/access connectors.
Treat BD71 post-Bobäcken line as an ambiguous Gamájåhkå/Vallevárre-side alternate until separately researched.
geometryPolicy.remainingAction: Normalization pass should implement a split-and-snap table using section research files, not this file alone.

commuteAccessPolicy.decision: Separate public transit hubs, scheduled boat/ferry access, helicopter access, and remote hut endpoints. Do not force every stage endpoint to have a conventional bus/train commute point.
commuteAccessPolicy.rationale: Padjelantaleden is remote; many official section endpoints are huts with no road access. Modeling hut-to-hut stages as if each endpoint has public transit would be misleading.
rules: Ritsem and Kvikkjokk are gateway commute endpoints.
Änonjálmme/Áhkká and Bobäcken are boat/ferry access endpoints.
BLT/STF huts without scheduled transit are remote trail endpoints.
Fiskflyg stops should be access metadata using published route/stop names; do not import standalone helipad POIs without exact published coordinates.
Line boats or local boat shuttles without stable landing coordinates should be access metadata unless exact landings are verified.
commuteAccessPolicy.remainingAction: Recheck all 2026 access providers before publication because schedules are dynamic.

facilityImportPolicy.decision: Import major huts, stations, shelters, ferry terminals, and verified named infrastructure. Attach unseparated hut services to the parent hut rather than importing standalone POIs without coordinates.
facilityImportPolicy.rationale: Public sources verify many services at hut/camp level but generally do not publish coordinates for individual dry toilets, emergency phones, water points, waste, or wood sheds. Importing guessed coordinates would violate the no-invented-coordinates rule.
importAsFacilities: STF/BLT hut camps with published hut coordinates.
STF Kvikkjokk and STF Ritsem gateway facilities.
Bobäcken shelter/landing if final snap is verified against OSM/Naturkartan/source data.
Named bridges and official route infrastructure where coordinates are mapped and source confidence is sufficient.
attachToParentFacility: Hut dry toilets unless separately mapped and verified.
Hut emergency phones unless separately mapped and verified.
Hut water collection notes unless separately mapped and verified.
Hut waste, wood, sauna, kitchen, payment, and provisions notes.
suppressOrKeepPending: OSM-only firepits until official or field verification.
Informal campsites/tent pitches without durable coordinates.
Helicopter landing points without published coordinates.
Guaranteed food/provisions for Tarrekaise and Njunjes because current STF pages do not list shops.
Guaranteed Stáloluokta grocery/kiosk resupply because current text says only small sales may occur and Parfa's kiosk has stopped.
facilityImportPolicy.remainingAction: Normalization pass should classify each section facility as import, attach, suppress, pending, or accessMetadata.

rulesAndSafetyPolicy.decision: Static park rules are sufficiently resolved for research; operational safety remains dynamic and requires publication-time recheck.
staticRulesResolved: Dogs are prohibited in Padjelanta/Badjelánnda during summer and autumn; leashed dogs are allowed 1 January-30 April.
Fire is allowed using loose ground material, but cutting/breaking wood, shrubs, or bark is prohibited; obey fire bans.
Drone/aircraft operation, dog sledding, organized larger/repeated activities, and low aircraft start/landing require relevant permission.
Cycling is prohibited inside national parks and reserves except on specified roads.
Fishing requires correct permit and is only allowed in specified waters.
dynamicRisksToRecheck: Road to Ritsem service changes due to train work.
Pärlälven/Försvarsmakten closure status near the southern approach.
rulesAndSafetyPolicy.confidence: high for static rules; medium for current 2026 conditions
